names.note: Name page 13814 of days.pravoslavie.ru gives the surname the day line omits. The grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, as BRIEF-RUSSIAN §3 asks. `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE.

death.note: The day line closes «(1940)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 20 июля ст. ст. — «Прмч. Феодора (1940).»

attestations.note: The day's seventh entry, and THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS: no life page behind it. «послушник» is the office `Novice`, which the addendum names as one of the three grades the four locale packs carry; NO `monk` WAS WRITTEN IN `types`, a novice not being a monk, and the corpus's `types` vocabulary has no word for one. «Прмч.» is the `venerable-martyr`. `new-martyr` as elsewhere on this day, and THE 26 ЯНВАРЯ SYNAXIS PAGE WAS NOT OPENED. No folder held him. The day page prints no hymn under his name.
